# ankra_helm_registries (Data Source)

Lists the Helm registries the organisation sees, the platform's global registries included. The counterpart of `ankra helm registries list`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_helm_registries" "all" {}

output "registry_names" {
  value = [for registry in data.ankra_helm_registries.all.registries : registry.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source.
- `registries` (Attributes List) Helm registries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--registries))

<a id="nestedatt--registries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `registries`

Read-Only:

- `chart_count` (Number) Charts indexed from the registry.
- `credential_name` (String) Attached registry credential, if any.
- `exclude_charts` (List of String) Charts left out of the catalogue (HTTP registries).
- `is_global` (Boolean) Whether the platform provides the registry to every organisation.
- `kind` (String) `oci` or `http`.
- `last_sync_error` (String) Why the most recent index sync failed, when it did.
- `name` (String) Registry name, as an addon's `registry_name`.
- `url` (String) Registry URL, as an addon's `registry_url`.
